title: project-local-config
description: The parsed content of projects/<code>/local/config.toml in the workspace: the project layer of the configuration plus `[repo] path`, the code repository of the project on this machine. Not portable: it holds an absolute path and is never in git (the workspace .gitignore lists local/). The TOML file has no `$schema` key; this contract is validated against the parsed tables.

schema_version.description: Version of the configuration file format (the same number every configuration layer file carries).

repo.description: The code repository of the project on this machine; replaces the entry of the project in bindings.json.

path.description: Absolute real path of the checkout (the primary one of the project).

^(?!(?:schema_version|repo)$)[a-z][a-z0-.description: The table of one module of the project layer, named by the module id (`[planner.bridges]`, `[orch.conductor]`, ...; any name but `schema_version` and `repo`); its keys belong to that module's own configuration schema and are checked there, not here.
